sources.title: Harman et al., Effect of elevated embryonic incubation temperature on the temperature preference of juvenile lake and round whitefish
sources.geographicScope: Laboratory shuttle-box; twelve-month juvenile round whitefish
sources.endpoint: Thermal selection after developmental incubation treatments, DOI 10.1093/conphys/coad067
sources.finding: Round-whitefish groups were 55-62 mm, 1.19-1.71 g. Group mean upper avoidance 15.11-15.80 C; lower avoidance 13.04-13.73 C after common rearing at 15 C.
